capability.summary: Check rustfmt edition 2021 formatting from one Rust entry file without rewriting files
capability.description: Executes exactly `rustfmt --check --edition 2021 <entry-file>`. The CLI entry is one file, but rustfmt can discover and recursively check out-of-line modules unless configuration changes child handling; `--check` keeps all checked files unmodified.
capability.problem_space: Read-only rustfmt conformance checking rooted at one Rust entry file under fixed edition 2021, potentially including discoverable out-of-line modules; not isolated-single-file assurance, source rewriting, Clippy, compilation, tests, or multi-edition selection.

env_requirements: any intended rustfmt configuration must be discoverable by rustfmt
constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing Rust source file. Executes `rustfmt --check --edition 2021 <file>` with inherited cwd. Output: JSON execution envelope with rustfmt exit_code and captured stdout/stderr; source is not intentionally rewritten.
accepted_inputs: an existing Rust entry source file intended for edition 2021 rustfmt checking, with any recursively discovered out-of-line module files also authorized for read-only checking
constraint.output_shape: rustfmt exit 0 or 1: {status: "success", tool: "rustfmt", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}, wrapper exit 0. Other rustfmt exits: same keys with status="tool_error" and the rustfmt exit code is propagated. Missing file, executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "rustfmt", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: check-only invocation: `--check` is fixed and the wrapper does not rewrite the source file or return formatted source as a structured field
although only one entry file is passed, rustfmt may recursively discover and check out-of-line modules; the wrapper does not pass `--skip-children` and cannot guarantee isolated single-file scope
forces `--edition 2021` and exposes no edition, config-path, style-edition, skip-children, or other rustfmt options
does not compile Rust, run Clippy, lint semantics, or run tests; rustfmt parse/config errors must be distinguished from formatting differences by exit code and streams
uses a fixed 120-second timeout, inherited cwd/config discovery, and no output truncation

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing rustfmt check exit code and raw stdout/stderr; the Rust source is not rewritten.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: check Rust formatting from one entry file with rustfmt
verify an edition 2021 Rust module tree without rewriting files
negative_intents: format or rewrite Rust source files
guarantee checking only the entry file without following modules
run Clippy compile Rust or execute Cargo tests
check Rust editions other than fixed edition 2021
